anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.role: menu, or listbox when listRole is listbox
anatomy.notes: Rendered only while open is true.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.role: menuitem, or option when listRole is listbox
anatomy.action: Selects the item (calls onSelect with its value).

figma.note: The selection is reported through onSelect; the container owns value (ADR-026).

listRole.concept: new term: which ARIA role family the panel renders (menu or listbox); the same markup serves both

states.name: default
states.notes: Panel visible; items in resting state.

states.name: hover
states.notes: overlay.hover background on the hovered item.

states.name: focus
states.notes: Same overlay.hover background: items show focus with a highlight, not the global ring.

states.name: active
states.notes: Momentary press feedback (CSS :active): overlay.active background, one step past hover.

states.name: selected
states.notes: Brand text colour and semibold weight on the currently selected item (shown for the listbox role).

accessibility.role: menu or listbox (controlled via listRole prop)

keyboardInteractions.action: Closes the dropdown and returns focus to the trigger

Moves focus between items (single roving focus target — all items are tabIndex=-1; the owning component is responsible for programmatically focusing an item when the panel opens, matching the WAI-ARIA APG menu/listbox pattern)

box-shadow.reason: Two-layer drop shadow; the token set has no shadow or elevation tokens.

min-width.reason: 11.875rem (190px) matches no size token; the nearest are size.2000 (160px) and size.2750 (220px).

outline.reason: Menu items show focus with a background highlight instead of the global focus ring (the documented exception in the component conventions).

font-weight.reason: 600 equals font.weight.semibold; raw number in the CSS Module, to migrate to the token.
